class.name: DiffUtilItemCallback
class.brief_description: Compares individual list items for ListAdapter diffing.
class.description:
DiffUtilItemCallback is the port of [i]DiffUtil.ItemCallback[/i]: it compares two item objects to decide whether they represent the same data and whether their content changed. It is the diff callback used by [method ListAdapter.set_diff_callback] when submitting a new list.
[b]Subclass[/b]: [codeblock] class DiffCb extends DiffUtilItemCallback: func _are_items_the_same(old_item: Variant, new_item: Variant) -> bool: return old_item.id == new_item.id
func _are_contents_the_same(old_item: Variant, new_item: Variant) -> bool: return old_item.text == new_item.text [/codeblock]

method.name: _are_contents_the_same
method.description: Must override. Returns whether the two items have identical content; false dispatches a change update.

method.name: _are_items_the_same
method.description: Must override. Returns whether the two items represent the same data (used for move detection / stable identity).

method.name: _get_change_payload
method.description: Optional. Returns a payload for a change update, passed to [method Adapter._bind_item_with_payload].
